<title>Programação Semanal</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Barlow:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Painel TV — Programação Semanal. Paleta sóbria: cinzas industriais + laranja ZAMine
   apenas em filetes, indicadores e barras de progresso. Fotos em escala de cinza. */
:root{
  --bg:#0d0c0b; --panel:#17150e13; --panel:#181614; --panel2:#211e1b; --panel3:#2a2622;
  --line:#2e2a26; --line2:#3f3933;
  --fg:#f5f2ee; --fg2:#d2cbc3; --muted:#9b948b; --muted2:#6d6760;
  --accent:#ff6600; --accent-soft:#ff66001f;
  --on-accent:#120800;
  --f-display:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Barlow","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
  color-scheme:dark;
}
html,body{height:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:var(--f-body);overflow:hidden}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
button{font-family:inherit;color:inherit}

/* ---------- palco 1920x1080 ---------- */
#viewport{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000;overflow:hidden}
#stage{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;transform-origin:0 0;
  background:var(--bg);display:grid;grid-template-rows:120px 1fr 88px;overflow:hidden}

/* ---------- cabeçalho ---------- */
.hd{display:grid;grid-template-columns:430px 1fr 430px;align-items:center;padding:0 56px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.brand .logo{height:80px;width:auto;display:block}
.brand small{display:block;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  line-height:1.4;border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:20px}
.hd-title{text-align:center}
.hd-title .eyb{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.hd-title h1{margin:3px 0 0;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:700;font-size:50px;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1}
.hd-title .rule{width:76px;height:3px;background:var(--accent);margin:9px auto 0}
.clock{text-align:right}
.clock b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:600;font-size:58px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.01em}
.clock span{display:block;font-size:18px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:capitalize;margin-top:2px}

/* ---------- área do slide ---------- */
#main{position:relative;padding:34px 56px 30px;overflow:hidden}
.s-prog{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr;gap:24px;height:100%}

/* barra de semana */
.wk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}
.wkb{width:54px;height:54px;flex:none;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);border-radius:8px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:34px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,color .15s}
.wkb:hover{background:var(--panel3);border-color:var(--line2)}
.wkb:active{background:var(--line)}
.wkb.txt{width:auto;padding:0 20px;font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.wkb.txt:hover{color:var(--fg)}
.wk-lbl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;min-width:330px;padding-left:4px;
  border-left:3px solid var(--accent);padding-left:20px}
.wk-lbl b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:58px;font-weight:700;line-height:.95;text-transform:uppercase}
.wk-lbl span{font-size:21px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em;margin-top:2px}
.wk-sum{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:14px}
.sm{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 24px;min-width:132px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.sm b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:42px;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.sm span{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}
.sm.lead{border-color:var(--line2)}
.sm.lead b{color:var(--accent)}

/* tira de dias */
.days{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:12px}
.day{position:relative;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;
  padding:12px 14px 14px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;min-height:110px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s}
.day::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:transparent}
.day:hover{background:var(--panel3);border-color:var(--line2)}
.day .dn{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.day .dd{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:40px;font-weight:700;line-height:.95}
.day .dtags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-top:auto}
.day .dtags i{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:19px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;
  background:var(--panel3);border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--fg2);border-radius:5px;padding:1px 8px}
.day .free{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted2);margin-top:auto;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
.day.has{border-color:var(--line2)}
.day.has .dd{color:var(--fg)}
.day.has::after{background:var(--line2)}
.day.today .dn{color:var(--accent)}
.day.today::after{background:var(--accent)}
.day.sel{background:var(--panel2);border-color:var(--accent)}
.day.sel::after{background:var(--accent)}
.day.sel .dtags i{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--fg)}
.day.dim{opacity:.34}

/* cards de máquina */
.grid-p{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;min-height:0}
.mach{position:relative;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;padding:0;
  transition:border-color .18s,background .18s,transform .18s}
.mach::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:3px;background:var(--line);z-index:2}
.mach.has::before{background:var(--accent)}
.mach:hover{border-color:var(--line2);background:var(--panel2);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.mach.dim{opacity:.3}
.mach-ph{height:146px;flex:none;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel2);position:relative}
.mach-ph img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;filter:contrast(1.04) saturate(1.06) brightness(.98)}
.mach-ph::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,var(--panel) 0%,#18161400 62%)}
.mach-bd{padding:16px 24px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;flex:1;min-height:0}
.mach-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
.mach-top .tag{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:52px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.01em}
.mach-top .mod{font-size:17px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
.mach-st{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.kv{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-width:0}
.kv label{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.kv b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:31px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap}
.kv.r{text-align:right}
.why{margin:0;font-size:20px;line-height:1.32;color:var(--fg2);display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;
  -webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.nostop{margin:0;font-size:20px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em}
.bk{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex:1;min-height:0}
.bk-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
.bk-h span{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.bk-h em{font-style:normal;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.bar{height:5px;background:var(--panel3);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s}
.bk ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;overflow:hidden;flex:1;min-height:0}
.bk li{font-size:18px;line-height:1.26;color:var(--fg2);display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.bk li::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted2);flex:none;margin-top:7px}
.bk li.ok{color:var(--muted2);text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:var(--line2)}
.bk li.ok::before{background:var(--accent)}
.bk li.rest{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em}
.bk li.rest::before{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.mach-cta{margin-top:auto;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);
  font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.mach:hover .mach-cta{color:var(--accent)}

/* vazio */
.empty{display:grid;place-items:center;height:100%;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:26px}
.empty b{display:block;color:var(--fg);font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:62px;text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.empty .rule{width:64px;height:3px;background:var(--accent);margin:18px auto 0}

/* ---------- rodapé ---------- */
.ft{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto auto 1fr auto;align-items:stretch;border-top:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.ft::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:-1px;width:220px;height:2px;background:var(--accent)}
.ft .cell{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:0 34px;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}
.ft .cell:first-child{padding-left:56px}
.ft .cell b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:46px;font-weight:800;line-height:1}
.ft .cell samp{font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.12em;line-height:1.15;color:var(--muted)}
.ft .msg{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 34px;font-size:21px;color:var(--fg2);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.ft .keys{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:0 56px 0 24px}
.ft .keys span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em}
kbd{font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line2);
  border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:5px;padding:2px 7px;color:var(--fg2);min-width:22px;text-align:center}

/* ---------- detalhe da máquina (sobre o palco) ---------- */
#detail{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:20;background:#0d0c0bf2;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:56px}
#detail[hidden]{display:none}
.dt{width:100%;max-width:1560px;max-height:100%;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line2);
  border-radius:12px;display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;overflow:hidden}
.dt-h{display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 1fr auto;gap:28px;align-items:center;padding:24px 32px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2)}
.dt-ph{width:230px;height:140px;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel3)}
.dt-ph img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;filter:contrast(1.04) saturate(1.06) brightness(.98)}
.dt-id{min-width:0}
.dt-id .tag{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:66px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;display:block}
.dt-meta{display:flex;gap:28px;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.dt-meta div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.dt-meta label{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.dt-meta b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.dt-why{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:22px;color:var(--fg2);line-height:1.3;border-left:3px solid var(--accent);padding-left:14px}
.dt-x{align-self:start;background:var(--panel3);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 18px;
  font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.dt-x:hover{background:var(--line);color:var(--fg)}
.dt-bd{overflow:auto;padding:26px 32px 30px}
.dt-bh{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:16px;margin-bottom:6px}
.dt-bh h3{margin:0;font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:34px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
.dt-bh span{font-size:19px;color:var(--muted)}
.dt-bar{height:6px;background:var(--panel3);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin:12px 0 22px}
.dt-bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s}
.bkl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.bki{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:9px;padding:16px 20px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;font:inherit;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s}
.bki:hover{background:var(--panel3);border-color:var(--line2)}
.bki .ck{width:30px;height:30px;flex:none;border:2px solid var(--line2);border-radius:6px;display:grid;
  place-items:center;font-size:19px;line-height:1;color:transparent;margin-top:1px;transition:all .15s}
.bki .n{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);flex:none;
  width:30px;text-align:center;margin-top:5px}
.bki .tx{font-size:22px;line-height:1.3;min-width:0}
.bki.ok{border-color:var(--line2)}
.bki.ok .ck{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent)}
.bki.ok .tx{color:var(--muted2);text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:var(--line2)}
.dt-none{font-size:24px;color:var(--muted);padding:20px 0}

/* ---------- editor ---------- */
#editor{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:40;background:var(--bg);display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;font-size:15px}
#editor[hidden]{display:none}
.ed-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-block:14px;
  padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel)}
.ed-top h2{margin:0;font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:26px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-right:auto}
.ed-top .st{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.ed-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 1fr;min-height:0}
.ed-nav{border-right:1px solid var(--line);overflow:auto;padding:12px}
.ed-nav button{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;font:500 15px var(--f-body);background:none;border:0;
  color:var(--fg);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}
.ed-nav button:hover{background:var(--panel2)}
.ed-nav button.on{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.ed-main{overflow:auto;padding-block:24px;
  padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.ed-main h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:30px;text-transform:uppercase}
.ed-main .hint{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 20px;max-width:65ch;line-height:1.5}
.part{margin-bottom:26px;max-width:1040px}
.fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:14px}
.fld{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.fld.wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.fld label{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
input,select,textarea{font:15px var(--f-body);background:var(--panel);color:var(--fg);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:6px;padding:9px 10px;width:100%;min-width:0}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:-1px;border-color:var(--accent)}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:170px;line-height:1.5;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
input[readonly]{background:var(--panel2);color:var(--fg2)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:6px;
  background:var(--panel2);color:var(--fg);font:600 14px var(--f-body);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.btn:hover{background:var(--line)}
.btn.accent{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.btn.accent:hover{background:#e65c00}
.cnt{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);background:var(--panel2);
  border:1px solid var(--line2);padding:12px 20px;border-radius:8px;z-index:60;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s}
.toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}

@media (max-width:760px){
  .ed-body{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr}
  .ed-nav{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px}
  .ed-nav button{white-space:nowrap;width:auto}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}
</style>

<div id="viewport">
  <div id="stage">
    <header class="hd">
      <div class="brand">
        <img class="logo" alt="ZAMine" src="data:image/png;base64,">
        <small>Manutenção<br>Alto Horizonte</small>
      </div>
      <div class="hd-title">
        <div class="eyb">Hitachi EX2600 · EH-01 / 02 / 03</div>
        <h1>Programação Semanal</h1>
        <div class="rule"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="clock">
        <b id="clk">--:--</b>
        <span id="clkd">—</span>
      </div>
    </header>

    <div id="main">
      <div class="s-prog">
        <div class="wk">
          <button class="wkb" id="wk-prev" title="Semana anterior">‹</button>
          <button class="wkb" id="wk-next" title="Semana seguinte">›</button>
          <div class="wk-lbl">
            <b>Semana <span id="wk-num" class="num">--</span></b>
            <span id="wk-per">—</span>
          </div>
          <button class="wkb txt" id="wk-today">Semana atual</button>
          <div class="wk-sum">
            <div class="sm lead"><b id="sm-par" class="num">0</b><span>Paradas</span></div>
            <div class="sm"><b id="sm-hrs" class="num">0h</b><span>Horas</span></div>
            <div class="sm"><b id="sm-bk" class="num">0</b><span>Backlogs</span></div>
            <div class="sm"><b id="sm-ok" class="num">0%</b><span>Concluído</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="days" id="days"></div>

        <div class="grid-p" id="cards"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <footer class="ft">
      <div class="cell"><b id="ft-wk" class="num">--</b><samp>Semana<br>ISO</samp></div>
      <div class="cell"><b id="ft-par" class="num">0</b><samp>Paradas<br>na semana</samp></div>
      <div class="msg"><span id="ft-per">—</span></div>
      <div class="keys">
        <span><kbd>‹</kbd><kbd>›</kbd> Semana</span>
        <span><kbd>1</kbd><kbd>2</kbd><kbd>3</kbd> Máquina</span>
        <span><kbd>E</kbd> Editar</span>
      </div>
    </footer>

    <div id="detail" hidden>
      <div class="dt">
        <div class="dt-h">
          <div class="dt-ph"><img id="dt-img" alt=""></div>
          <div class="dt-id">
            <span class="tag" id="dt-tag">—</span>
            <div class="dt-meta">
              <div><label>Parada</label><b id="dt-dia">—</b></div>
              <div><label>Duração</label><b id="dt-hrs">—</b></div>
              <div><label>Modelo</label><b>EX2600</b></div>
            </div>
            <p class="dt-why" id="dt-why">—</p>
          </div>
          <button class="dt-x" id="dt-x">Fechar <kbd>Esc</kbd></button>
        </div>
        <div class="dt-bd">
          <div class="dt-bh"><h3>Backlogs Programados</h3><span id="dt-cnt">—</span></div>
          <div class="dt-bar"><i id="dt-fill" style="width:0%"></i></div>
          <div id="dt-list"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="editor" hidden>
  <div class="ed-top">
    <h2>Editor — Programação Semanal</h2>
    <span class="st" id="ed-st"></span>
    <button class="btn" id="ed-close">Cancelar</button>
    <button class="btn accent" id="ed-save">Salvar e exibir</button>
  </div>
  <div class="ed-body">
    <nav class="ed-nav" id="ed-nav">
      <button class="on" data-t="geral">Semana</button>
      <button data-t="EH-01">EH-01</button>
      <button data-t="EH-02">EH-02</button>
      <button data-t="EH-03">EH-03</button>
    </nav>
    <div class="ed-main" id="ed-main"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<script>
/* ===================== dados estáticos ===================== */
var PHOTOS = {"EH-01":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","EH-02":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","EH-03":"data:image/jpeg;base64,"};
var TAGS = ["EH-01","EH-02","EH-03"];
var DIAS = ["Segunda","Terça","Quarta","Quinta","Sexta","Sábado","Domingo"];
var DIAS_ABR = ["Seg","Ter","Qua","Qui","Sex","Sáb","Dom"];

/* ===================== utilidades ===================== */
function esc(s){var d=document.createElement("div");d.textContent=s==null?"":String(s);return d.innerHTML;}
function pad(n){return n<10?"0"+n:""+n;}
function fmtDM(d){return pad(d.getDate())+"/"+pad(d.getMonth()+1);}

function isoWeekStart(year,week){
  var jan4=new Date(year,0,4);
  var dow=jan4.getDay()||7;
  var mon=new Date(year,0,4-dow+1+(week-1)*7);
  mon.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  return mon;
}
function weeksInISOYear(year){
  var d=new Date(year,11,28);
  return isoWeekOf(d);
}
function isoWeekOf(dt){
  var d=new Date(Date.UTC(dt.getFullYear(),dt.getMonth(),dt.getDate()));
  var n=d.getUTCDay()||7;
  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()+4-n);
  var ys=new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(),0,1));
  return Math.ceil((((d-ys)/864e5)+1)/7);
}
function isoYearOf(dt){
  var d=new Date(Date.UTC(dt.getFullYear(),dt.getMonth(),dt.getDate()));
  var n=d.getUTCDay()||7;
  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()+4-n);
  return d.getUTCFullYear();
}
function sameDay(a,b){return a.getFullYear()===b.getFullYear()&&a.getMonth()===b.getMonth()&&a.getDate()===b.getDate();}

/* ===================== armazenamento ===================== */
function key(y,w){return "zam_prog_"+y+"_W"+pad(w);}
function load(y,w){
  try{var r=localStorage.getItem(key(y,w));return r?JSON.parse(r):null;}catch(e){return null;}
}
function save(y,w,data){
  try{localStorage.setItem(key(y,w),JSON.stringify(data));return true;}catch(e){return false;}
}
function blank(){
  var m={};TAGS.forEach(function(t){m[t]={dia:"",horas:"",motivo:"",backlogs:"",done:[]};});
  return {machines:m};
}
function getWeek(y,w){
  var d=load(y,w);
  if(!d||!d.machines)return blank();
  TAGS.forEach(function(t){
    if(!d.machines[t])d.machines[t]={dia:"",horas:"",motivo:"",backlogs:"",done:[]};
    if(!Array.isArray(d.machines[t].done))d.machines[t].done=[];
  });
  return d;
}
function bkList(m){
  return (m.backlogs||"").split("\n").map(function(s){return s.trim();}).filter(function(s){return s.length;});
}

/* ===================== estado ===================== */
var now=new Date();
var ST={y:isoYearOf(now),w:isoWeekOf(now),selDay:null,open:null};

/* ===================== relógio ===================== */
function tick(){
  var n=new Date();
  document.getElementById("clk").textContent=pad(n.getHours())+":"+pad(n.getMinutes());
  document.getElementById("clkd").textContent=n.toLocaleDateString("pt-BR",{weekday:"long",day:"numeric",month:"long"});
}
tick();setInterval(tick,15000);

/* ===================== escala do palco ===================== */
function scale(){
  var vw=window.innerWidth,vh=window.innerHeight,s=Math.min(vw/1920,vh/1080),st=document.getElementById("stage");
  st.style.transform="scale("+s+")";
  st.style.left=((vw-1920*s)/2)+"px";
  st.style.top=((vh-1080*s)/2)+"px";
}
window.addEventListener("resize",scale);scale();

/* ===================== render ===================== */
function render(){
  var d=getWeek(ST.y,ST.w);
  var mon=isoWeekStart(ST.y,ST.w);
  var sun=new Date(mon);sun.setDate(mon.getDate()+6);
  var today=new Date();

  /* cabeçalho da semana */
  document.getElementById("wk-num").textContent=pad(ST.w);
  document.getElementById("wk-per").textContent=fmtDM(mon)+" — "+fmtDM(sun)+" · "+ST.y;
  document.getElementById("ft-wk").textContent=pad(ST.w);
  document.getElementById("ft-per").textContent="Período de "+fmtDM(mon)+" a "+fmtDM(sun)+" de "+ST.y
    +(isoWeekOf(today)===ST.w&&isoYearOf(today)===ST.y?"  ·  semana em curso":"");

  /* totais */
  var par=0,hrs=0,bkT=0,bkO=0;
  TAGS.forEach(function(t){
    var m=d.machines[t],l=bkList(m);
    if(m.dia)par++;
    var h=parseFloat(String(m.horas||"").replace(",",".").replace(/[^0-9.]/g,""));
    if(!isNaN(h))hrs+=h;
    bkT+=l.length;
    l.forEach(function(_,i){if(m.done.indexOf(i)>-1)bkO++;});
  });
  document.getElementById("sm-par").textContent=par;
  document.getElementById("sm-hrs").textContent=(hrs%1?hrs.toFixed(1):hrs)+"h";
  document.getElementById("sm-bk").textContent=bkT;
  document.getElementById("sm-ok").textContent=(bkT?Math.round(bkO/bkT*100):0)+"%";
  document.getElementById("ft-par").textContent=par;

  /* tira de dias */
  var days=document.getElementById("days");days.innerHTML="";
  for(var i=0;i<7;i++){
    var dt=new Date(mon);dt.setDate(mon.getDate()+i);
    var tagsHere=TAGS.filter(function(t){return d.machines[t].dia===DIAS[i];});
    var cls="day";
    if(tagsHere.length)cls+=" has";
    if(sameDay(dt,today))cls+=" today";
    if(ST.selDay===i)cls+=" sel";
    else if(ST.selDay!==null)cls+=" dim";
    var b=document.createElement("button");
    b.className=cls;b.setAttribute("data-d",i);
    b.innerHTML='<span class="dn">'+DIAS_ABR[i]+'</span><b class="dd num">'+pad(dt.getDate())+'</b>'
      +(tagsHere.length
        ?'<div class="dtags">'+tagsHere.map(function(t){return "<i>"+t+"</i>";}).join("")+'</div>'
        :'<span class="free">Sem parada</span>');
    days.appendChild(b);
  }

  /* cards */
  var wrap=document.getElementById("cards");wrap.innerHTML="";
  if(par===0&&bkT===0){
    wrap.style.display="block";
    wrap.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><div><b>Sem programação</b>'
      +'Nenhuma parada lançada para a semana '+pad(ST.w)+' ('+fmtDM(mon)+' — '+fmtDM(sun)+').<br>'
      +'Pressione <kbd>E</kbd> para abrir o editor.<div class="rule"></div></div></div>';
    return;
  }
  wrap.style.display="grid";

  TAGS.forEach(function(t,idx){
    var m=d.machines[t],l=bkList(m),ok=0;
    l.forEach(function(_,i){if(m.done.indexOf(i)>-1)ok++;});
    var dayIdx=DIAS.indexOf(m.dia);
    var dim=(ST.selDay!==null&&dayIdx!==ST.selDay);
    var dt=dayIdx>-1?new Date(mon):null;
    if(dt)dt.setDate(mon.getDate()+dayIdx);

    var a=document.createElement("button");
    a.className="mach"+(m.dia?" has":"")+(dim?" dim":"");
    a.setAttribute("data-tag",t);
    var head='<div class="mach-ph"><img src="'+PHOTOS[t]+'" alt="'+t+'"></div>'
      +'<div class="mach-bd"><div class="mach-top"><span class="tag">'+t+'</span>'
      +'<span class="mod">EX2600</span></div>';
    var body;
    if(m.dia){
      body='<div class="mach-st">'
        +'<div class="kv"><label>Parada</label><b>'+esc(m.dia)+(dt?" "+fmtDM(dt):"")+'</b></div>'
        +'<div class="kv r"><label>Duração</label><b>'+esc(m.horas||"—")+'</b></div></div>'
        +'<p class="why">'+esc(m.motivo||"Motivo não informado")+'</p>';
    }else{
      body='<div class="mach-st"><div class="kv"><label>Parada</label><b>Não programada</b></div>'
        +'<div class="kv r"><label>Duração</label><b>—</b></div></div>'
        +'<p class="nostop">Máquina segue em operação nesta semana.</p>';
    }
    var bk;
    if(l.length){
      bk='<div class="bk"><div class="bk-h"><span>Backlogs</span><em>'+ok+' / '+l.length+'</em></div>'
        +'<div class="bar"><i style="width:'+(l.length?ok/l.length*100:0)+'%"></i></div>'
        +'<ul>'+l.slice(0,3).map(function(s,i){
            return '<li class="'+(m.done.indexOf(i)>-1?"ok":"")+'">'+esc(s)+'</li>';
          }).join("")
        +(l.length>3?'<li class="rest">+ '+(l.length-3)+' backlog'+(l.length-3>1?"s":"")+'</li>':"")
        +'</ul>'
        +'</div><span class="mach-cta">'+(l.length>3?"Ver todos os "+l.length+" backlogs":"Abrir detalhes")+' →</span>';
    }else{
      bk='<div class="bk"><div class="bk-h"><span>Backlogs</span><em>0</em></div>'
        +'<div class="bar"><i style="width:0%"></i></div>'
        +'<ul><li style="color:var(--muted2)">Nenhum backlog lançado</li></ul></div>'
        +'<span class="mach-cta">Abrir detalhes →</span>';
    }
    a.innerHTML=head+body+bk+'</div>';
    wrap.appendChild(a);
  });
}

/* ===================== detalhe ===================== */
function openDetail(tag){
  var d=getWeek(ST.y,ST.w),m=d.machines[tag],l=bkList(m);
  var mon=isoWeekStart(ST.y,ST.w),di=DIAS.indexOf(m.dia);
  var dt=di>-1?new Date(mon):null;if(dt)dt.setDate(mon.getDate()+di);
  ST.open=tag;
  document.getElementById("dt-img").src=PHOTOS[tag];
  document.getElementById("dt-tag").textContent=tag;
  document.getElementById("dt-dia").textContent=m.dia?(m.dia+(dt?" "+fmtDM(dt):"")):"Não programada";
  document.getElementById("dt-hrs").textContent=m.horas||"—";
  document.getElementById("dt-why").textContent=m.motivo||(m.dia?"Motivo não informado":"Máquina segue em operação nesta semana.");
  paintDetail();
  document.getElementById("detail").hidden=false;
}
function paintDetail(){
  var tag=ST.open;if(!tag)return;
  var d=getWeek(ST.y,ST.w),m=d.machines[tag],l=bkList(m),ok=0;
  l.forEach(function(_,i){if(m.done.indexOf(i)>-1)ok++;});
  document.getElementById("dt-cnt").textContent=l.length?(ok+" de "+l.length+" concluídos"):"nenhum lançado";
  document.getElementById("dt-fill").style.width=(l.length?ok/l.length*100:0)+"%";
  var box=document.getElementById("dt-list");
  if(!l.length){box.className="";box.innerHTML='<p class="dt-none">Nenhum backlog lançado para esta máquina nesta semana.</p>';return;}
  box.className="bkl";
  box.innerHTML=l.map(function(s,i){
    var on=m.done.indexOf(i)>-1;
    return '<button class="bki'+(on?" ok":"")+'" data-i="'+i+'">'
      +'<span class="ck">✓</span><span class="n num">'+pad(i+1)+'</span><span class="tx">'+esc(s)+'</span></button>';
  }).join("");
}
function closeDetail(){document.getElementById("detail").hidden=true;ST.open=null;}

function toggleDone(i){
  var d=getWeek(ST.y,ST.w),m=d.machines[ST.open];
  var p=m.done.indexOf(i);
  if(p>-1)m.done.splice(p,1);else m.done.push(i);
  save(ST.y,ST.w,d);
  paintDetail();render();
}

/* ===================== editor ===================== */
function edPanel(tab){
  var d=getWeek(ST.y,ST.w),h="";
  if(tab==="geral"){
    var mon=isoWeekStart(ST.y,ST.w),sun=new Date(mon);sun.setDate(mon.getDate()+6);
    h='<h3>Semana de referência</h3>'
     +'<p class="hint">Informe o ano e o número da semana ISO. O período é calculado automaticamente, '
     +'e cada semana guarda a sua própria programação.</p>'
     +'<div class="part"><div class="fields">'
     +'<div class="fld"><label>Ano</label><input type="number" id="f-ano" min="2020" max="2040" value="'+ST.y+'"></div>'
     +'<div class="fld"><label>Semana ISO (1–'+weeksInISOYear(ST.y)+')</label>'
     +'<input type="number" id="f-sem" min="1" max="53" value="'+ST.w+'"></div>'
     +'<div class="fld wide"><label>Período</label><input type="text" id="f-per" readonly value="'
     + fmtDM(mon)+" a "+fmtDM(sun)+" de "+ST.y+'"></div>'
     +'</div></div>';
  }else{
    var m=d.machines[tab],l=bkList(m);
    h='<h3>'+tab+' · Hitachi EX2600</h3>'
     +'<p class="hint">Deixe o dia em branco se a máquina não tem parada programada. '
     +'Os backlogs são lançados um por linha — cada quebra de linha vira um item na lista.</p>'
     +'<div class="part"><div class="fields">'
     +'<div class="fld"><label>Dia da parada</label><select id="f-dia">'
     +'<option value="">— Sem parada —</option>'
     + DIAS.map(function(x){
         var rot=(x==="Sábado"||x==="Domingo")?x:(x+"-feira");
         return '<option value="'+x+'"'+(m.dia===x?" selected":"")+'>'+rot+'</option>';
       }).join("")
     +'</select></div>'
     +'<div class="fld"><label>Duração programada</label>'
     +'<input type="text" id="f-hrs" placeholder="Ex: 12h" value="'+esc(m.horas||"")+'"></div>'
     +'<div class="fld wide"><label>Motivo da parada</label>'
     +'<input type="text" id="f-mot" placeholder="Ex: Manutenção preventiva 500h" value="'+esc(m.motivo||"")+'"></div>'
     +'<div class="fld wide"><label>Backlogs programados — um por linha <span class="cnt" id="f-cnt">'
     + l.length+(l.length===1?" item":" itens")+'</span></label>'
     +'<textarea id="f-bk" spellcheck="false" placeholder="BK-001 — Troca dos filtros hidráulicos&#10;'
     +'BK-002 — Inspeção dos pinos do boom&#10;BK-003 — Substituição de mangueira LH">'+esc(m.backlogs||"")+'</textarea></div>'
     +'</div></div>';
  }
  document.getElementById("ed-main").innerHTML=h;
  if(tab==="geral"){
    ["f-ano","f-sem"].forEach(function(id){
      document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("input",function(){
        var y=parseInt(document.getElementById("f-ano").value,10);
        var w=parseInt(document.getElementById("f-sem").value,10);
        if(!y||!w||w<1||w>53){document.getElementById("f-per").value="—";return;}
        var a=isoWeekStart(y,w),b=new Date(a);b.setDate(a.getDate()+6);
        document.getElementById("f-per").value=fmtDM(a)+" a "+fmtDM(b)+" de "+y;
      });
    });
  }else{
    var ta=document.getElementById("f-bk");
    ta.addEventListener("input",function(){
      var n=ta.value.split("\n").filter(function(s){return s.trim().length;}).length;
      document.getElementById("f-cnt").textContent=n+(n===1?" item":" itens");
    });
  }
}
var edTab="geral";
function collect(){
  var d=getWeek(ST.y,ST.w);
  if(edTab==="geral"){
    var y=parseInt(document.getElementById("f-ano").value,10);
    var w=parseInt(document.getElementById("f-sem").value,10);
    if(y&&w&&w>=1&&w<=53){pendY=y;pendW=w;}
  }else{
    var m=d.machines[edTab];
    m.dia=document.getElementById("f-dia").value;
    m.horas=document.getElementById("f-hrs").value.trim();
    m.motivo=document.getElementById("f-mot").value.trim();
    var old=bkList(m).length;
    m.backlogs=document.getElementById("f-bk").value;
    if(bkList(m).length!==old)m.done=m.done.filter(function(i){return i<bkList(m).length;});
    save(ST.y,ST.w,d);
  }
}
var pendY=null,pendW=null;
function openEditor(tab){
  pendY=null;pendW=null;edTab=tab||"geral";
  document.querySelectorAll("#ed-nav button").forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle("on",b.dataset.t===edTab);});
  edPanel(edTab);
  document.getElementById("ed-st").textContent="Semana "+pad(ST.w)+" / "+ST.y;
  document.getElementById("editor").hidden=false;
}
function closeEditor(){document.getElementById("editor").hidden=true;}

/* ===================== eventos ===================== */
document.getElementById("wk-prev").onclick=function(){
  ST.w--;if(ST.w<1){ST.y--;ST.w=weeksInISOYear(ST.y);}ST.selDay=null;render();
};
document.getElementById("wk-next").onclick=function(){
  var max=weeksInISOYear(ST.y);ST.w++;if(ST.w>max){ST.y++;ST.w=1;}ST.selDay=null;render();
};
document.getElementById("wk-today").onclick=function(){
  var n=new Date();ST.y=isoYearOf(n);ST.w=isoWeekOf(n);ST.selDay=null;render();toast("Semana atual: "+pad(ST.w));
};
document.getElementById("days").addEventListener("click",function(e){
  var b=e.target.closest(".day");if(!b)return;
  var i=parseInt(b.dataset.d,10);
  ST.selDay=(ST.selDay===i?null:i);render();
});
document.getElementById("cards").addEventListener("click",function(e){
  var c=e.target.closest(".mach");if(!c)return;openDetail(c.dataset.tag);
});
document.getElementById("dt-x").onclick=closeDetail;
document.getElementById("detail").addEventListener("click",function(e){
  if(e.target.id==="detail"){closeDetail();return;}
  var b=e.target.closest(".bki");if(b)toggleDone(parseInt(b.dataset.i,10));
});
document.getElementById("ed-nav").addEventListener("click",function(e){
  var b=e.target.closest("button");if(!b)return;
  collect();
  edTab=b.dataset.t;
  document.querySelectorAll("#ed-nav button").forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle("on",x===b);});
  edPanel(edTab);
});
document.getElementById("ed-close").onclick=function(){closeEditor();render();};
document.getElementById("ed-save").onclick=function(){
  collect();
  if(pendY&&pendW){ST.y=pendY;ST.w=pendW;}
  closeEditor();ST.selDay=null;render();
  toast("Programação da semana "+pad(ST.w)+" salva");
};
document.getElementById("ft-per").parentElement.style.cursor="pointer";
document.getElementById("ft-per").parentElement.onclick=function(){openEditor("geral");};

document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){
  var ed=!document.getElementById("editor").hidden;
  if(ed){
    if(e.key==="Escape"){closeEditor();render();}
    return;
  }
  if(!document.getElementById("detail").hidden){
    if(e.key==="Escape")closeDetail();
    return;
  }
  if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"){document.getElementById("wk-prev").click();}
  else if(e.key==="ArrowRight"){document.getElementById("wk-next").click();}
  else if(e.key==="1"||e.key==="2"||e.key==="3"){openDetail(TAGS[parseInt(e.key,10)-1]);}
  else if(e.key==="e"||e.key==="E"){openEditor("geral");}
  else if(e.key==="t"||e.key==="T"){document.getElementById("wk-today").click();}
  else if(e.key==="Escape"){ST.selDay=null;render();}
});

var tmr;
function toast(msg){
  var t=document.getElementById("toast");
  t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add("on");
  clearTimeout(tmr);tmr=setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove("on");},2600);
}

render();
</script>
